Tests that LLM max_concurrency is accepted independently of the extraction thread budget

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, ExtractionConfig, extract } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const input: ExtractInput = { kind: ExtractInputKind.Uri, mimeType: "text/plain", uri: "https://example.com/text/report.txt" };
  const config: ExtractionConfig = { captioning: { llm: { maxConcurrency: 2, model: "openai/gpt-4o" }, minImageArea: 1000 }, concurrency: { maxThreads: 8 } };
  const result = await extract(input, config);
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
